[[Rothgar Hoofsplitter]] is an [[armor]] collector, a type of [[NPC]] who trades armor pieces for [[trophy|trophies]]. 

==Locations==
*[[Northern Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Deldrimor Bowl}} (inside [[Graggult's Keep]])

:''"I'm searching for 5 [[Shiverpeak Mane]]s. I can offer you one of the following items in exchange. Can you help me?"''
